# SFNT test fixtures

`FiraSans-Regular.ttf` is the Fira Sans regular face, unmodified, used by
`tests/sfnt_resource.rs` as a real font with known tables and metrics. Fira Sans is
licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (<https://openfontlicense.org/>), not this
repository's licence. The other files here are small synthetic containers built for the
parser tests.
